Import packaged UI components.description: Import the packaged stateful companion UI kit (Pager / Toast / ConfirmDialog / Modal / theme) by dotted sub-path

Pager — packaged, controlled.description: Render the packaged Pager (controlled). Its buttons page_prev/page_next/goto_page fall through to your @ws loop

Toast — seed the per-connection instance.description: Seed the per-connection Toast instance in your render (pair with `let cid = Uuid.v4().to_str()`)

Toast — show a flash.description: Show a transient toast (kind: success / error / info). Pair with a `dismiss` dispatch at the top of the loop

ConfirmDialog — seed with labels.description: Seed the per-connection ConfirmDialog with already-localized labels

ConfirmDialog — open it (ask).description: Open the ConfirmDialog with the ids to act on + a formatted body message

ConfirmDialog — handle confirm (fall-thr.description: Handle the ConfirmDialog's confirm_delete (falls through to the host loop): read the pending ids, act, then close

Theme — drop in the default --flv-* toke.description: Emit the default --flv-* theme tokens (light + [data-theme="dark"]) in your <head>

Import packaged UI primitives.description: Import the packaged presentational primitives (Button / Card / Badge / Alert / Input / Spinner / Icon) by dotted sub-path

Button — packaged, presentational.description: Render the packaged Button (variant primary/secondary/danger/ghost). Its click fires the on_click event, which falls through to your @ws loop

body: let ${1:submit_html} = button_render(button { label: ${2:label}, variant: "${3:primary}", submit: true }).raw
Button (submit) — packaged, form submit.description: Render a packaged Button as a form submit (type="submit", no data-flv-click) to drive an enclosing <form data-flv-submit>

Card — packaged, presentational.description: Render the packaged Card (title escaped; body/footer are RAW HTML; elevation none/sm/md/lg; clickable variant)

Badge — packaged, presentational.description: Render the packaged Badge (variant primary/success/danger/info/muted, size sm/md)

Alert — packaged, presentational.description: Render the packaged Alert (variant info/success/warning/danger; dismissible fires on_dismiss)

body: let ${1:input_html} = input_render(input { name: "${2:field}", label: ${3:label}, value: ${4:value}, input_type: "${5:text}" }).raw
Input — packaged, controlled.description: Render the packaged Input (controlled: value lives in your form; read it back from the data-flv-submit payload by name)

body: let ${1:input_html} = input_render(input { name: "${2:field}", placeholder: ${3:placeholder}, required: true, clear: true, autocomplete: "off" }).raw
Input (live form) — packaged, required +.description: Render a packaged Input as a live-form field (required + data-flv-clear so the client empties it after a successful submit)

Spinner — packaged, presentational.description: Render the packaged Spinner (indeterminate by default; pass progress: 0..100 for a determinate ring)

Icon — packaged SVG.description: Emit a packaged 1em currentColor SVG icon (check/close/edit/trash/plus/search/chevron-*/... 23 baked in)

Modal — seed the per-connection instance.description: Seed the per-connection Modal instance in your render (pair with `let cid = Uuid.v4().to_str()`)

Modal — open it (show).description: Open the Modal, seeding its title + RAW body HTML. Close it with a `close` dispatch (or the × / backdrop click)
